Short title extent and commencement

ACT XII OF 1997
ACT XII OF 1997
NAZARIA‑E‑PAKISTAN FOUNDATION ACT, 1997
1. Short title and commencement. ‑‑‑(I) This Act may
be called the Nazaria‑e‑Pakistan Foundation Act, 1997.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Definitions

ACT XII OF 1997
ACT XII OF 1997
NAZARIA‑E‑PAKISTAN FOUNDATION ACT, 1997
2. Definitions. ‑In this Act, unless the context otherwise
requires‑‑‑
(a) "Board" means the
Board of Governors of the Foundation;
(b) "Foundation"
means the Nazaria‑e‑Pakistan Foundation;
(c) "Government"
means the Government of the Punjab.
(d) "Official member"
means a person holding a post under the Government; and
(e) "Trust" means the
Nazaria‑e‑Pakistan Trust registered under the Societies
Registration Act (XXI of 1860).

Establishment of the foundation

ACT XII OF 1997
ACT XII OF 1997
NAZARIA‑E‑PAKISTAN FOUNDATION ACT, 1997
3. Establishment of the
Foundation.‑‑‑(1) The Government may, by notification,
establish a Foundation to be called the 'Nazaria‑e‑Pakistan
Foundation'.
(2) The Foundation shall be a
body corporate, having perpetual succession and a common seal with power to
acquire, hold and dispose of property and shall by the said name sue and be
sued.

Board

ACT XII OF 1997
ACT XII OF 1997
NAZARIA‑E‑PAKISTAN FOUNDATION ACT, 1997
4. Board.‑‑‑(1)
The management, overall control and supervision of the affairs of the
Foundation shall vest in a Board, which shall be appointed by the Government.
(2) The Board shall consist of
such number of members as the Government may determine.
(3) The Government shall
appoint one of the members as the Chairman of the Board.
(4) Except for official
members, a person appointed to the Board shall be a person of eminence in this
field.
(5) The term of office of a
member of the Board, other than an official member, shall be five years but the
Government may remove a member before the expiry of his term on the ground of
misconduct or inaptitude or mental or physical incapacity.

Secretary

ACT XII OF 1997
ACT XII OF 1997
NAZARIA‑E‑PAKISTAN FOUNDATION ACT, 1997
5. Secretary. ‑‑‑(I)
There shall be a Secretary of the Foundation.
(2) The Secretary shall be
appointed by the Government on such terms and conditions as it may determine.
(3) The Secretary shall be the
Member/Secretary of the Board and Chief Executive of the Foundation and shall
be responsible to the Board for carrying out the objectives of the Foundation.

Powers and functions

ACT XII OF 1997
ACT XII OF 1997
NAZARIA‑E‑PAKISTAN FOUNDATION ACT, 1997
6. Powers and functions.‑‑(1)
Subject to the provisions of this Act, and any rules framed thereunder, the
Foundation may exercise such powers and take such measures as may be necessary
for carrying out the purposes of this Act.
(2) Without prejudice to the
generality of the foregoing subsection, the Foundation shall‑‑‑
(i) propagate and project the
ideology of Pakistan;
(ii) preserve the spirit,
memory and record of the Pakistan Movement;
(iii) trace, record and honour
the contributions and sacrifices made for the establishment of Pakistan;
(iv) contribute to the
endeavours to establish in Pakistan the promised social order based on Islam;
(v) promote national unity and
fight against all forms of disunity and exploitation; and
(vi) work as a national,
autonomous, ideological and democratic body to promote the aims and objects set
out in the Objectives Resolution as enshrined in the Constitution.

Foundation fund

ACT XII OF 1997
ACT XII OF 1997
NAZARIA‑E‑PAKISTAN FOUNDATION ACT, 1997
7. Foundation Fund.‑‑‑There
shall be a fund to be known as the Nazaria- e‑Pakistan Foundation Fund
which shall be vested in the Foundation and to which shall be credited all sums
received by the Foundation.

Source of fund

ACT XII OF 1997
ACT XII OF 1997
NAZARIA‑E‑PAKISTAN FOUNDATION ACT, 1997
8. Source of Funds.‑‑‑The
Funds of the Foundation shall be derived from the following sources:‑‑
(i) all moneys, rights,
properties and assets standing in the name of the Trust;
(ii) grants of the Federal
Government and the Provincial Governments;
(iii) contributions and
donations from any source; and
(iv) such other sources as may
be determined by the Government

Budget, audit and account

ACT XII OF 1997
ACT XII OF 1997
NAZARIA‑E‑PAKISTAN FOUNDATION ACT, 1997
9. Budget, Audit and Account.‑‑‑The
budget of the Foundation shall be approved and its accounts shall be maintained
and audited in such manner as may be prescribed.

Officers, advisers, etc.

ACT XII OF 1997
ACT XII OF 1997
NAZARIA‑E‑PAKISTAN FOUNDATION ACT, 1997
10. Officers, advisers, etc.‑‑‑(1)
The Foundation may appoint such officers, advisers, experts, consultants and
employees as it considers necessary for the efficient performance of its
functions on such terms and conditions as it may deem fit.
(2) All direct appointments
shall be made on merit, determined through open competition, from amongst duly
qualified persons.

Rules

ACT XII OF 1997
ACT XII OF 1997
NAZARIA‑E‑PAKISTAN FOUNDATION ACT, 1997
11. Rules.‑‑‑The
Government may make rules for carrying out the purposes of this Act.

Regulations

ACT XII OF 1997
ACT XII OF 1997
NAZARIA‑E‑PAKISTAN FOUNDATION ACT, 1997
12. Regulations.‑‑‑‑The
Foundation may by notification make regulations, not inconsistent with the
provisions of the rules, for the administration and management of the affairs
of the Foundation.

Dissolution of Nazaria-e-Pakistan trust

ACT XII OF 1997
ACT XII OF 1997
NAZARIA‑E‑PAKISTAN FOUNDATION ACT, 1997
13. Dissolution of Nazaria‑e‑Pakistan
Trust.‑‑‑On the establishment of the Foundation, the Trust
shall stand dissolved and all its powers, rights, properties and assets shall
vest in and its liabilities shall be the liabilities of the Foundation.

Repeal

ACT XII OF 1997
ACT XII OF 1997
NAZARIA‑E‑PAKISTAN FOUNDATION ACT, 1997
14. Repeal.‑‑‑The
Nazaria‑e‑Pakistan Foundation Ordinance, 1997 (XXIX of 1997) is
hereby repealed.
